subject: Quiet-window launch: runbook & tissue-call finalization
messages:
From: Elena Soto <elena.soto@northstar.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ops Team <ops@northstar.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Mar 2028 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Final launch prep: quiet-window runbook/ops checks

Grace —

Thanks again for walking us through the Private VPC deployment last week. We're on track for the quiet-window launch the week of Apr 2, and I wanted to share the draft acceptance matrix and our suggested 2-hour maintenance window. Please review the attached acceptance matrix and the proposed runbook excerpts.

Open items from our side we want to validate with you:
- NTP and time drift windows across on-prem nodes (we saw small skews in staging)
- ACLs between customer transit and Redwood egress (we'll supply firewall rules)
- KV cache priming order for the first 15 minutes of traffic
- Fallback routing to the regional hosted tier if capacity is exceeded

Can we lock the tissue-call time for T0 + 15 / +45 minutes after flip? Proposing Apr 3 01:00 UTC. We'll include our DB ops lead and carrier NOC.

Attaching: acceptance-matrix-NS-2028.xlsx (see section 3), runbook-excerpt.pdf

—Elena
Elena Soto
SR. Cloud Ops Manager | NorthStar Telecom
Elena.Soto@northstar.com

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Soto <elena.soto@northstar.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 23 Mar 2028 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Final launch prep: quiet-window runbook/ops checks

Elena —

Appreciate the matrix and the excerpt. I'm comfortable with the suggested quiet-window slot (Apr 3 01:00 UTC) for a low-traffic midnight flip at your end. Confirming we will:

- Run the explicit NTP sync play at T-30 and verify with 'ntpq -p' on each gateway node.
- Apply the firewall ACLs you provided to the customer transit interfaces at T-15; Redwood will validate flows from our side.
- Kick the KV cache priming sequence in this order: control-plane keys -> small prefix warmup (top 100 prefixes) -> full prefix sweep. We'll provide a priming log endpoint so you can observe progress.
- Implement the routing fallback policy: within 60s of capacity threshold breach the system will drain to the hosted tier; rollback trigger is either sustained token error rate > 2.5% for 3 minutes or tail-latency p95 > 600ms for 2 minutes.

Tissue-call: T0 + 15 and T0 + 45 sounds right. We'll join from our NYC ops room and have the engineer on-call paging enabled.

Attached: runbook-v1.3.pdf (final candidate) and a preliminary quiet-window-schedule.csv. Please confirm you're good with the rollback triggers above; if so I'll issue the final runbook and signoff.

Thanks —
Grace O'Connor
Head of Private Delivery | Redwood Inference
grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0186

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Final launch prep: quiet-window runbook/ops checks

Quick checklist additions we should confirm before T0: 

- BGP adjacencies fully established on all edge routers; confirm RIB consistency with 'show ip bgp summary' from both sides.
- MTU and fragmentation policy: customer to set 1500, we will tag and honor DF across the transit.
- TLS cert chain and OCSP stapling: certs loaded to keystore v2 and validated via the cert-check script.
- Observability: streaming logs to the shared workspace for the first 30 minutes; set log-level to INFO and capture first 3000 request traces for smoke sampling.
- KV priming sanity: attach the kv-primer-run.log.txt to the runbook packet (we'll run a dry priming tonight).

Elena — can you confirm carrier NOC contact for the tissue-call and whether they'll run their own BFD sessions? If they won't, we need to keep BGP timers conservative for T0+0..+30.

Monica
Monica Patel

Subject: Re: Final launch prep: quiet-window runbook/ops checks

All — final signoff from leadership side on the planned runbook-v1.3 and the quiet-window cadence. A couple of operational clarifications and the go/no-go matrix I want visible in the tissue-call: 

1) Go criteria (all must be true):
   - KV primer completed with zero missing keys for the first 60s after T0.
   - Control-plane connectivity green (API p99 < 120ms).
   - Firewall ACLs applied and verified (confirmed flows from NorthStar test agent).

2) No-go / rollback triggers (any of these will initiate immediate rollforward to hosted tier and postmortem):
   - Token error rate > 2.5% sustained for 3 minutes.
   - P95 latency breach > 600ms for more than 2 minutes.
   - Unexpected route flap on the customer transit (BGP MRAI violations or repeated withdraws in 60s).

3) If we hit a no-go, the ops script will: run immediate traffic drain, flip egress routes, and signal customer NOC. We'll keep a 45-minute window for stabilization before attempting a re-open.

Please ensure DocuSign final signoff is completed by Apr 1 18:00 UTC; Aditya, can you chase the contract sig?

Marissa Cole
VP, Product Operations | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

(Attachment: runbook-v1.3.pdf, quiet-window-schedule.csv, kv-primer-run.log.txt)
